description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerPasswordStrengthService class, which extends PasswordStrengthService to implement password policy checks specific to the installer component of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving password policy parameters and validating passwords against those policies, with mechanisms for lazy initialization and customizable password rules.
external_methods: PasswordStrengthService methods: checkMinPasswordLength, checkMaxPasswordLength, checkMinLowercaseLetters, checkMinUppercaseLetters, checkMinNumbersInPassword, checkMinSpecialCharacters, checkSpacesInPassword

classes.name: InstallerPasswordStrengthService
classes.description: Class extending PasswordStrengthService to enforce password policies in the installer component, including min and max length, character variety, and space restrictions.

methods.name: getTextHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextHelperService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum password length setting, defaulting to 8.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum password length setting, defaulting to 64.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of lowercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of uppercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of numerical digits required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of special characters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether spaces are allowed in passwords, defaulting to 'false'.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Validates a UserCredential's password against defined policies and returns an array of violation messages.
